name: Koi no Jiken wa Totsuzen ni
source:
You were just living out your ordinary college days, when one day, you noticed someone’s shadow pursuing you…their target was your precious pendant!

How fortunate for you that the acquaintance you were sent to stay with runs a detective office. Four handsome detectives with distinct personalities are staying there as well!

You overcome many difficulties and slowly approach the truth behind everything. Over time, the distance between you and the man you choose draws closer…

What is the true identity of the person after your pendant? What will be the outcome of your love!?

[from [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/120069494261/the-fateful-encounter-%E6%81%8B%E3%81%AE%E4%BA%8B%E4%BB%B6%E3%81%AF%E7%AA%81%E7%84%B6%E3%81%AB]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
你正過著普通的大學生活，某天卻注意到有人影跟蹤自己……對方的目標是你珍貴的墜飾！

幸運的是，你被送去投靠的熟人經營著一家偵探事務所，而且那裡還住著四名性格各異的英俊偵探！

你克服重重困難，逐漸接近一切背後的真相。隨著時間流逝，你與所選男子之間的距離也不斷縮短……

追逐墜飾的人究竟是誰？你的戀情又會迎來怎樣的結局！？
